CustomObject.label: Rowhouse Bench Record
CustomObject.description: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Test-only object holding the published benchmark rows (test-data/scripts/generate-benchmark.py, or RowhouseBenchData from Anonymous Apex). Kept apart from Rowhouse_Test_Record__c so the 56 edge-case rows, some of them deliberately pathological, never enter a timing. Fourteen generated columns plus five formulas: twenty with Name. Never packaged.
